params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $testCommit=(git log -1 --format=%H -- heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py).Trim(); Write-Output ('TEST_FILE_COMMIT='+$testCommit); git status --short; python -m py_compile heaven-bridge\worker.py heaven-bridge\test_worker.py heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; $compile=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('PY_COMPILE_EXIT='+$compile); python -m unittest -v heaven-bridge\test_worker.py; $primary=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('PRIMARY_EXIT='+$primary); python -m unittest -v heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py; $secondary=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('SECONDARY_EXIT='+$secondary); if($compile -ne 0){exit 41}; if($primary -ne 0){exit 42}; if($secondary -ne 0){exit 43}; exit 0
